decisions.reason: Value has largely resolved favourably, with proven government use and over 30 APIS connections, so the firm should commit further rather than abandon it.
Demand for travel health requirements is fading after the pandemic and uncertainty is high, but an API costs little to maintain and has its own page, so the firm keeps the option open for now.
A cyber awareness training module is cheap to keep alongside the firm's certified training resources, and its value is still uncertain, so retaining it preserves upside.
Behaviour analysis is core to the firm's specialist detection expertise and has expansion potential into new sectors, and its prospects are still unresolved, so the option is worth holding.
Passenger profiling builds on established aviation security know-how and costs little to sustain, while its value is still emerging, so the firm keeps it.
The verification web platform sits close to the established offer with low marginal cost and has a dedicated page, so it is retained while its results develop.
